title: Count words
evidence: Reported: Berlin SE2/SSE1 2021 and SEII 2022
stream_fit: Possible via tokenization followed by counting, but a loop is clearer and avoids token allocation. Match the exact whitespace contract; default regex \s is not identical.

title: Match character-repetition patterns
evidence: Reported: Berlin SEII 2022
stream_fit: Good for filtering the list with a pure matches(word,pattern) helper. Implement the bijection inside that helper with local maps; avoid shared mutable state.

title: Convert camelCase to snake_case
evidence: Reported: Delivery Hero senior SWE; date/location unspecified
stream_fit: Possible using an index IntStream and joining, but adjacent-character rules are simpler with StringBuilder. Do not force a Stream solution.

title: Convert nested map keys to camelCase
evidence: Reported: Glovo Spain backend; Java attempt, not Berlin
stream_fit: Possible with entry streams plus recursion. A toMap merge rule must reject collisions; a recursive loop is usually easier to explain.

title: Compare OCR encodings
evidence: Reported: Berlin SE2/SSE1 2021; numeric grammar reconstructed
stream_fit: Poor fit: comparing variable-length logical runs requires coordinated state. Use a scanner/two pointers and long counters.

title: First non-repeated code point
evidence: Recommended string/Stream practice; not established as a DH question
stream_fit: Good fit: codePoints() and frequency counting, then encounter-order selection. chars() splits supplementary characters; specify key ordering.

title: Group anagrams
evidence: Recommended pattern/collector practice; not established as a DH question
stream_fit: Good fit: grouping by a canonical key; use an insertion-ordered map to satisfy group order. Explain sorted-key cost.

title: Encode consecutive runs
evidence: Recommended string scanning; not established as a DH question
stream_fit: Poor fit: adjacent runs and boundary state are clearer in a loop; groupingBy loses run boundaries.

title: Reverse word order
evidence: Recommended string manipulation; not established as a DH question
stream_fit: Possible with tokenization, reversed indices and joining; a normal list reversal is simpler. A Stream has no general reverse operation.

title: Check normalized palindrome
evidence: Recommended string/two-pointer practice; not established as a DH question
stream_fit: Possible to filter/lowercase code points then compare, with O(n) intermediate storage. Two pointers avoid that allocation.

title: Filter and map values
evidence: General Java Stream interview practice; no DH-specific attribution
stream_fit: Use Stream API for the main transformation. Understand lazy intermediate versus terminal operations.

title: Second-largest DISTINCT value
evidence: General Java Stream interview practice; no DH-specific attribution
stream_fit: Use Stream API for the main transformation. Be explicit about duplicates and empty Optional; sorting costs O(n log n).

title: Count word frequencies
evidence: General Java Stream interview practice; no DH-specific attribution
stream_fit: Use Stream API for the main transformation. Counting and ordered collection; HashMap does not promise encounter order.

title: Flatten nested lists and deduplicate
evidence: General Java Stream interview practice; no DH-specific attribution
stream_fit: Use Stream API for the main transformation. Explain map versus flatMap and ordered distinct.

title: Sum salaries by department
evidence: General Java Stream interview practice; no DH-specific attribution
stream_fit: Use Stream API for the main transformation. Nested grouping and summing; avoid int overflow.

title: Highest-paid employee per department
evidence: General Java Stream interview practice; no DH-specific attribution
stream_fit: Use Stream API for the main transformation. Choose a deterministic comparator/merge; do not leave tie behavior accidental.

title: Partition by salary threshold
evidence: General Java Stream interview practice; no DH-specific attribution
stream_fit: Use Stream API for the main transformation. Explain partitioning versus grouping.

title: Convert list to map with duplicate IDs
evidence: General Java Stream interview practice; no DH-specific attribution
stream_fit: Use Stream API for the main transformation. toMap needs an explicit collision policy; distinct compares whole records, not IDs.

title: Sort employees with deterministic ties
evidence: General Java Stream interview practice; no DH-specific attribution
stream_fit: Use Stream API for the main transformation. Compose comparators; subtracting numeric values can overflow.

title: Reduce a total safely
evidence: General Java Stream interview practice; no DH-specific attribution
stream_fit: Use Stream API for the main transformation. Use a neutral identity and associative addition; never mutate an external accumulator.
